name: EPIC 201636269
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 8.7 solar radii and 1.02 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201636269 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.728788 (16th-84th percentiles 8.443217-9.078786), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201636269 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.018402 (16th-84th percentiles 0.94321-1.121486), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201636269: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4650.265 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201636269 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3215.507812 (16th-84th percentiles 3132.617188-3308.476562), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.09 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,216 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.02 solar masses and 8.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,650 K at its surface.
